what_does_it_do: It's a guide for implementers who want to add security to their NMOS Nodes and/or NMOS Controllers, according to the [IS-10](https://specs.amwa.tv/is-10/), [BCP-003-01](https://specs.amwa.tv/bcp-003-01/), [BCP-003-02](https://specs.amwa.tv/bcp-003-02/) and [BCP-003-03](https://specs.amwa.tv/bcp-003-03/) specifications.
Please note that this guide is informative and therefore is not a substitute for reading the normative specifications.
why_does_it_matter: This guide makes the job of adding security to your NMOS implementations easier.
how_does_it_work: It details what you need to know, and the steps you need to take when implementing security.
It also mentions some tools to help in your implementation.
